channel.title: AI-MarkDone - ChatGPT Reader, Markdown Copy, LaTeX, Bookmarks, Export
channel.description: Read long ChatGPT answers, copy Markdown, write and export formulas, add highlights and annotations, and organize bookmarks in Library.

item.title: Write formulas in the input box
item.description: Write Markdown and LaTeX directly in ChatGPT’s existing input box. AI-MarkDone can suggest commands and preview formulas while you type, so you do not have to send a formula to ChatGPT just to check its appearance.

item.title: Workflows
item.description: Read a long answer and take notes Suppose you ask ChatGPT to explain the FFT. The answer contains the DFT formula, a complexity comparison table, and several sections.

item.title: Troubleshooting and common questions
item.description: Start with the symptom that matches your problem. For missing controls or display issues, check Settings and refresh first. Do not begin by uninstalling the extension, which can remove local Library data that has not been backed up.

item.title: Settings reference
item.description: Where to open it Click the AI-MarkDone brand / settings button at the bottom right of ChatGPT, then open Settings. Browse the eight categories below or search by setting name. Reader text size, window behavior, and annotation copy format are in the settings button at the top right of Reader, covered at the end of this page.

item.title: Reader
item.description: Reader opens one ChatGPT answer in a separate reading view, with formatted headings, paragraphs, lists, code, tables, and formulas. While reading a long answer, you can keep your place, collect earlier passages, record questions, and move between answers.

item.title: Partial copy
item.description: Partial copy takes a passage from an answer. It works on the original ChatGPT page and in Reader, with slightly different shortcuts and handling for structured content.

item.title: Move through a long conversation
item.description: The right-side directory helps you find a reply among many messages. Previous / Next at the lower right moves between adjacent replies. These controls navigate messages in a ChatGPT conversation; Reader’s heading outline navigates sections inside one reply.

item.title: Install and get started
item.description: AI-MarkDone is available as a desktop extension for Chrome and Firefox. Use it on ChatGPT after installation; you do not need a separate AI-MarkDone account.

item.title: Highlights
item.description: Use highlights to mark passages you want to revisit without writing a comment. Highlights work on the ChatGPT page and in Reader, and save in the current browser.

item.title: Export messages and offline files
item.description: Open Export from a reply toolbar or directory preview to save selected questions and replies locally. Text, code, formulas, and charts have different output needs. Choose a format and check the selected messages before saving.

item.title: Excerpt tray
item.description: The Excerpt tray is a temporary comparison area inside Reader. Keep an earlier assumption, formula, or conclusion beside the text while reading later sections, without scrolling back to find it. The feature previously called Sticky now appears as Excerpt tray in the interface.

item.title: Copy and export formulas
item.description: Click a formula in a reply to copy its source. To put a formula in a presentation or document, use the copy and save actions above it. Formulas you have not sent yet can also be previewed and exported: see Writing formulas in the input box .

item.title: Copy a reply as Markdown
item.description: Copy Markdown gives you answer text that can be edited further. Headings, lists, quotations, tables, code, and formulas with available source retain their corresponding syntax where possible. Content preferences and the destination editor also affect the result.

item.title: Bookmarks and Library
item.description: Library brings together bookmarks, highlights, and annotations. There are two kinds of bookmarks: message bookmarks save a snapshot of one answer and its corresponding question; page bookmarks save a page name and URL.

item.title: Back up, import, and move your Library
item.description: Export the local Library before changing browsers, moving devices, or uninstalling the extension. A Library backup is different from exporting a reply as Markdown or PDF. The backup restores saved items; a message export is for reading or editing.

item.title: Back up your Library to Google Drive
item.description: Google Drive backup keeps a copy of your saved Library in your own Google account. It is currently marked Experimental and must be started manually. It is neither automatic synchronization nor two-way syncing. Connecting an account alone does not upload your Library.

item.title: Annotations
item.description: An annotation pairs a passage with your comment. Select a step in a derivation and write “Explain why this step is valid,” or select a paragraph and write “Reduce this to two sentences.” Record several notes, then collect them into one follow-up.

item.title: AI-MarkDone Privacy
item.description: Scope This page describes how the AI-MarkDone extension handles data for reading, copying, formula editing, message navigation, annotations, highlights, bookmarks, exports, and backups.

item.title: AI-MarkDone manual
item.description: This manual covers AI-MarkDone in ChatGPT. Start with Installation , or follow a workflow to complete a task from reading to saving.
